segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the table, preparing to interact with the plug.
The robot arm descends and grasps the plug on the table.
The robot arm lifts the plug from the table and moves it towards the power strip.
The robot arm positions the plug over the power strip, preparing to insert it.
The robot arm inserts the plug into the power strip.
The robot arm releases the plug and begins to retract from the power strip.
The robot arm moves away from the power strip and returns to its initial position.
